# A randomized weak nested cycle implements the required channel

All diamond norms below are full diamond norms, without a factor of one half.
Only the native controls and motion promise in the frozen `CONTROL_TASK.md`
are used. Memory includes its spectator throughout.

## Theorem

For every admitted fixed, coin-independent drift and every requested
`epsilon > 0`, a finite schedule of the allowed native evolutions has

\[
\left\|\operatorname{Tr}_M\circ\mathbb E\operatorname{Ad}_{U}
 -\operatorname{Ad}_{E}\circ\operatorname{Tr}_M\right\|_\diamond
 \leq\epsilon.
\]

The bound includes all initial data-memory-reference correlations. One
explicit family has total duration `O(epsilon^-2)`, at most
`O(epsilon^-3)` native segments, and `O(log(1/epsilon))` timing bits.
The constants given here are deliberately loose and extremely large.

For the exactly specified durations, the averaged *joint* channel is
close to a data gate tensor a
deterministic, instance-dependent bath unitary. This stronger statement is
only a comparison theorem; the bath unitary need not be known or controlled.

## 1. The interaction frame needs no drift-norm bound

Let `V(t)` be the propagator of `H_M(t)` alone and put

\[
S_j(t)=V(t)^\dagger\sigma_jV(t).
\]

These are Hermitian involutions, preserve the simultaneous Pauli algebra,
and satisfy

\[
\|S_j(t)-S_j(s)\|\leq |t-s|.
\tag{1}
\]

Indeed, their almost-everywhere derivative is
`i V(t)^dagger [H_M(t),sigma_j] V(t)`, of norm at most one.
Piecewise continuity gives the integral statement (1). No derivative of
`H_M`, its norm, or a spectator-dimension bound is invoked.

The controlled Hamiltonians in this frame are

\[
J_A(t)=X_1\otimes S_x(t),\quad
J_B(t)=X_2\otimes S_y(t),\quad
J_C(t)=Y_1\otimes S_z(t).
\]

They are fixed functions of absolute time, independently of the private
coins. All cycles below have the same duration for every coin outcome.

## 2. The actual ten-segment schedule

For each cycle, draw fresh independent fair signs `s_A,s_B` and set
`s_C=s_A s_B`. Use the following **chronological** segments, each of duration
`delta`, with the displayed native strength:

| Segment | Handle | Strength |
|---:|:---:|:---:|
| 1 | B | `-s_B` |
| 2 | C | `-s_C` |
| 3 | B | `+s_B` |
| 4 | C | `+s_C` |
| 5 | A | `-s_A` |
| 6 | C | `-s_C` |
| 7 | B | `-s_B` |
| 8 | C | `+s_C` |
| 9 | B | `+s_B` |
| 10 | A | `+s_A` |

# A uniform randomized native entangler

This is a proof for the exact interface in `../../packet/CONTROL_TASK.md`. All
norms on channels below are diamond norms, without a factor of one half. The
proof is dimension independent. No norm bound on the bath Hamiltonian is used.

## The schedule and theorem

Put `F = Z_1 X_2`, with a bath identity understood. One cycle has ten pulses,
each of duration `d`, in the following **chronological** order:

| Pulse | Handle | Strength |
|---:|:---:|:---:|
| 1 | B | -s_B |
| 2 | C | -s_C |
| 3 | B | +s_B |
| 4 | C | +s_C |
| 5 | A | -s_A |
| 6 | C | -s_C |
| 7 | B | -s_B |
| 8 | C | +s_C |
| 9 | B | +s_B |
| 10 | A | +s_A |

Here `s_A,s_B` are independent fair private signs and `s_C=s_A s_B`.
Draw two **fresh independent signs in every cycle**. The cycle length `10d`
and every switching time are independent of the signs. There are no other
operations and no idle times.

**One-cycle theorem.** For `L=10d <= 1`, and any starting time, the averaged
joint data-memory channel in the bath interaction frame obeys

\[
\left\|\Phi-\operatorname{Ad}_{e^{-4id^3 F}\otimes e^G}\right\|_\diamond
\le \frac54 L^4. \tag{1}
\]

Here `G` is an anti-Hermitian bath-only operator depending on the unknown bath
trajectory in that cycle. The controller does not compute it. Its norm obeys
`||G|| <= L^3/6`.

**Full-gate theorem.** Choose an integer `N` and

\[
d=\left(\frac{\pi}{16N}\right)^{1/3},\qquad 10d\le1.
\]

Then, uniformly over all admitted piecewise-continuous bath Hamiltonians, all
finite spectator dimensions, and all correlated input states,

\[
\left\|\overline{\mathcal C}_{DM\to D}
-\operatorname{Ad}_{E}\circ\operatorname{tr}_M\right\|_\diamond
\le \frac{3125\pi}{4}\,d. \tag{2}
\]

The reference is already included by the diamond norm. This proves the
requested approximate randomized reachability.

## Removing only the irrelevant bath motion

Let `V_0(t)` solve `dV_0/dt=-i H_M(t)V_0`, and define

\[
S_j(t)=V_0(t)^\dagger\sigma_j V_0(t).
\]

For almost every time,

\[
\frac{d S_j}{dt}=iV_0(t)^\dagger[H_M(t),\sigma_j]V_0(t).
\]

Consequently each `S_j` is norm-one and 1-Lipschitz. The three `S_j(t)` obey
the simultaneous Pauli algebra at every time. These statements hold even if
`||H_M(t)||` is arbitrarily large. Piecewise continuity and finite dimension
justify the integral identity and hence the Lipschitz estimate across joins.

The full unknown-gain, first-local-motion entangler question remains unresolved in both blocks. All six returns say this correctly. I found substantial valid partial results, with different domains: barriers for a completed commuting scalar library, adversarial noise for fixed weak native words, finite coarse approximations in block 1, and an all-native action bound in one block 2 return. These domains must remain separate when comparing returns.

**Exposure and assessment limits.** I started with the assessment instructions and masked index, without an inherited constructor conversation. Global runtime instructions supplied a generic workspace memory summary; I did not retrieve memory files or use that summary as scientific evidence. I read the frozen control task, the two capsules and next-scope questions, both checkpoint proofs, all six assigned scientific reports and their proof/code artifacts, and the three supplied predecessor theory documents. I did not read the private map, study plan, policy/context/procedure prompts, coordinator conclusions, other assessors' reports, original production histories, or unrelated original paths. The scientific copies themselves include stylistic and provenance clues, so concealed arm names do not guarantee perfect treatment blindness. I did not infer or assign policy labels. This is a completed source-exposed mathematical assessment with selected computational verification; it is not exhaustive formal verification, a literature-wide novelty determination, or hardware validation.

**Common contract and baseline.** The target is the fixed data channel of E=exp(-i pi F/4), F=Z1 X2, for all static gains g_A,g_B,g_C in [1,2], all admitted coin-independent time-dependent baths, and all initial data-memory-reference correlations. Only one native signed handle of amplitude at most one may act at a time. No calibration, preparation, measurement, reset, new meter, bath inverse, or additional logical gate is supplied. The first local commutator bound makes the interaction-frame Pauli axes Lipschitz; it supplies no bound on bath norm, bandwidth, or higher derivatives. Bath-only final evolution is irrelevant after the final memory trace.
